description: Score two synthetic support tickets against a landed rubric, citing the ticket body.
instruction:
Score each support ticket against the landed triage rubric.

severity_score: 1-5. 5 = production outage affecting all users. 4 = major
feature broken for many users. 3 = a workflow is degraded but a workaround
exists. 2 = cosmetic or single-user annoyance. 1 = question or feature request,
nothing broken.

triage_verdict: one of escalate, standard, backlog. Escalate at severity 4 or
above. Backlog only at severity 1.

Cite the verbatim span of the ticket body that the score rests on. Quote
exactly. If the ticket body does not state enough to score a field, return the
absent sentinel rather than guessing.

target_fields.name: severity_score
target_fields.description: Severity on the landed 1-5 scale. The RANGE is enforced by the harness, not by the API.

target_fields.name: triage_verdict
target_fields.description: One of the landed verdict enum. The ENUM is enforced on the wire.
